actual_matcher.llvm_body:
define i32 @"Text.Multipart.equal-sixteen.llvm"(i64 %0, i64 %1, i8 %2) #8 {
entry:

      %lo = bitcast i64 %0 to <8 x i8>
      %hi = bitcast i64 %1 to <8 x i8>
      %bytes = shufflevector <8 x i8> %lo, <8 x i8> %hi, <16 x i32> <i32 0, i32 1, i32 2, i32 3, i32 4, i32 5, i32 6, i32 7, i32 8, i32 9, i32 10, i32 11, i32 12, i32 13, i32 14, i32 15>
      %one = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 %2, i64 0
      %needle = shufflevector <16 x i8> %one, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer
      %same = icmp eq <16 x i8> %bytes, %needle
      %mask = bitcast <16 x i1> %same to i16
      %wide = zext i16 %mask to i32
      ret i32 %wide
}
